description: What tpu-llmd hands llmd-productionizer once the user has approved promoting a study's incumbent. The incumbent is the complete configuration; this request only says where it goes, how it is exposed, and what acceptance must show. Nothing here can change the configuration that was measured.

prompt.description: The promotion the user approved, in a sentence: which incumbent, into which namespace.

run_id.description: The session run; the production bundle is filed under its llmd artifacts.

study_id.description: The study whose incumbent is promoted; its rounds become the search ledger.

incumbent_config_path.description: The llmd-config.json the study ended on. Promoted byte-for-byte except for the production settings the productionizer is allowed to add (EPP replicas, HA mode).

production_namespace.description: Where the production release is applied. On an adopted fleet this must be the fleet's own namespace.

promotion_approved.description: Must be true. The user said, in this session, that the incumbent goes to production. The productionizer refuses anything else and the orchestrator never sets it on its own.

release_name.description: DNS label for the production release; default `<study_id>-prod` truncated to 40.

exposure.description: Front door in front of the router. cluster-ip adds nothing a shared cluster must approve; internal-lb asks GKE for an internal passthrough load balancer.

epp_replicas.description: EPP replicas for production; 2 gives an active-passive pair under the chart's leader election.

epp_ha_mode.description: Only read when epp_replicas > 1. Default active-passive; active-active only when every tuned plugin reads model-server-pulled state.

baseline_report_path.description: The incumbent arm's bench report; acceptance must land inside the noise floor of it or better.

acceptance.description: How the promoted release is re-measured in its production namespace before the bundle calls it accepted.

drills.description: Fault drills to run after acceptance. Only drills the runtime implements are listed; anything else the design names is reported UNVERIFIED.

existing_production_release.description: Name of a production release already serving this fleet, if any. The productionizer refuses to apply a second one over it without the user saying what happens to the first.

examples.prompt: Promote the acme-chat-tpu7x incumbent to the serving namespace.
